articles.summary: Wells Fargo Company (NYSE: WFC) today announced dividends on six series of preferred stock. Wells Fargo sign on a building exterior. A quarterly cash dividend of $18.75 per share was declared on its 7.50% noncumulative perpetual convertible class A preferred stock, Series L, liquidation preference $1,000 per share, which is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “WFCPrL”. The Series L dividend is payable on Dec. 15, 2026, to holders of record as of the close of business on Nov. 30, 2026. A quarterly cash dividend of $351.56 per share was declared on its 5.625% noncumulative perpetual class A preferred stock, Series Y, liquidation preference $25,000 per share. This dividend equals $0.35156 per depositary share, each representing a 1/1,000 interest in a share of Series Y preferred stock, which is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “WFCPrY”. articles.summary: National survey examines veterans’ perspectives on career progress, financial well-being and the future of artificial intelligence A new Wells Fargo survey, conducted by Morning Consult, finds veteran respondents report stronger outcomes than non-veterans across career satisfaction, financial confidence and readiness for an AI-enabled workplace. The research also identifies a continuing challenge: nearly half of veterans say the transition from military to civilian life was difficult. Wells Fargo Military Veterans Survey graphic featuring two uniformed U.S. military service members walking outside a Wells Fargo location. The survey highlights career satisfaction, financial confidence, artificial intelligence and employer support. The online survey, conducted by Morning Consult Oct. 1–11, 2026, included 4,000 U.S. adults: 2,000 veterans and 2,000 non-veterans.
